checks.detail: Outward normals are actual negatives of constructed normalized Riesz coordinate conormals; unit length and pairwise nonparallelism are proved.
The actual halfspace cone is identified with the actual positive generated three-ray cone using the independently proved basis-coordinate geometry.
Each original facet ray is pulled back by the explicit inverse archived orthogonal chart; the bundled Euclidean linear isometry proves norm and inner preservation.
The actual planar facet chart cone is proved exactly the positive wedge of the two pulled-back remaining rays, with no incidence or angle identity assumed.
The wedge angular-area theorem identifies each actual facet weight with the arccos inner product of the two original unit generators.
The checked arbitrary-count actual-cone spherical balance is then instantiated and oriented inward, yielding the exact factor2 and its true area norm bound.

This is trihedral cone geometry. Its use for original polyhedral strata is justified by the separately proved AE-threshold three-span exclusion; it does not claim the manuscript all-threshold nonsimple-face selection/merging bridge.
